items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know you got to do that by Buddy Johnson and Jack.

ctx.x: He did? He played with Buddy Ball then too.
I know you got to do that by Buddy Johnson and Jack. Yeah, he was strong. Do you know Ned's name, is that his last name? P-V-D-Q Ned. I think that is right. P-V-D-Q Ned. What?

items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the mention of 'Bud Williams or Bud something' or confirm any personal interaction; the name is only mentioned by the interviewer.

ctx.x: The one that had the good bands, I heard Tats Waller out of it.

Well, it must be the bands where all the bands go. We had a package. We had a real good show. We had Pops and, we had Stanley. Stanley, that's what, yeah, Stanley. Pops and Lloyd, we had, we had these two comedians, they were very good. Bud Williams or Bud something, and Boyd, Bud and Boyd I believe they called themselves. And they were good. Remember Bucking Bubbles? No, no, it wasn't Bucking Bubbles. We had this girl, this woman here, some Wilson. She was a singer. Edith Wilson? Edith Wilson was on with us. You…
You really liked the brass band?
